theorems.statement: The finite X/Y source is deterministically generated from O(a,b) chart frames: p0=r,p1=a-r,q0=s,q1=b-s; target continuation is enabled iff both target exponents are nonnegative.
For every primary parameter, every generated nonfinal state and every remaining word, quotient execution and fine algebraic execution have identical ACCEPT/REJECT output.
theorems.strength: 1208/1208 EXACT FINITE CHECKS + general signature theorem

theorems.statement: Equality of complete remaining suffix signatures is the unique coarsest equivalence sufficient for all coordinates of that declared suffix language.
For the declared algebraic source, q_i classes equal the source-native RegSupp/toric-pole-support classes at every nonfinal cut.
theorems.strength: GENERAL FOUR-CASE ALGEBRAIC PROOF + SIX-PARAMETER EXACT REPLAY

theorems.statement: Single-factor chart swaps conjugate source transitions and transport suffix signatures exactly; the U11-root alternative presentation is obtained by both swaps.
theorems.strength: EXACT FINITE BIJECTION ON ALL SIX PRIMARY PARAMETERS

theorems.statement: The algebraic factor swap sends O(a,b) to O(b,a), (r,s,i,j) to (s,r,j,i), and interchanges X/Y; generated source and suffix behavior commute with this map.
theorems.strength: EXACT ON O(1,1) PRIMARY + O(1,0)->O(0,1) CONTROL
